WITH payout_eur AS (
  SELECT p.tenant_id,
         p.gross_amount / er.rate AS gross_eur,
         p.fee_amount / er.rate AS fee_eur
  FROM payouts p
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR' AND er.quote_code = p.currency_code AND er.as_of = date(p.paid_at)
  WHERE p.status = 'paid' AND p.paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
tenant_agg AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, SUM(gross_eur) AS gross_eur, SUM(fee_eur) AS fee_eur
  FROM payout_eur
  GROUP BY tenant_id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.industry), ''), 'Unspecified') AS vertical,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ta.tenant_id) AS merchant_count,
  ROUND(SUM(ta.gross_eur)::numeric, 2) AS gross_payment_volume_eur,
  ROUND(SUM(ta.fee_eur)::numeric, 2) AS fee_revenue_eur,
  ROUND((SUM(ta.fee_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT ta.tenant_id))::numeric, 2) AS avg_fee_revenue_per_merchant_eur,
  ROUND((100.0 * SUM(ta.fee_eur) / SUM(SUM(ta.fee_eur)) OVER ())::numeric, 2) AS share_of_total_fee_revenue_pct
FROM tenant_agg ta
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = ta.tenant_id
GROUP BY vertical
ORDER BY fee_revenue_eur DESC, vertical ASC
note: Aggregated payouts per tenant first (converting gross/fee to EUR per-row via exchange_rates on paid_at date, avoiding the join fan-out from last night), then grouped by tenants.industry into verticals, exactly as specified.
